comments.text: Kimchi is delicious even when eaten about a day after it is made, and even if it has fermented deeply and become sour, it boasts an excellent flavor when eaten with pork in stews or grilled dishes. Kimchi can be enjoyed by cooking it in various ways. If foreigners learn how to properly enjoy kimchi, they probably won't be able to give it up.
